meta.name: AML 7-dimension local self-test suite
meta.disclaimer: 内部自测集，非官方基准数据集，结果仅作内部优化参考
meta.note: 所有用例为人工设计的确定性合成样本，与 AML 官方评测数据无关。评分基于 Search 返回的原始记忆证据做透明命中判定。

dimensions.G: 上下文学习与规则执行

judge_types.contains: 任一 value 子串（忽略大小写）出现在返回记忆 content 中即命中
judge_types.contains_all: 所有 value 子串均在返回记忆中命中（可跨多条记忆）
judge_types.not_contains: 所有 value 子串均不得出现在返回记忆中
judge_types.empty: 返回 data 必须为空数组
judge_types.count_eq: 包含指定 value 的记忆条数必须等于 n

messages.content: I am a software engineer.
I live in Boston, Massachusetts.
My wedding anniversary is on March 15th.
I drive a blue Toyota Corolla.
My employee ID number is 4821.
I have a cat named Luna.
I have a dog named Max.

I have been meaning to reorganize the garage and fix the garden shed this weekend, paint the fence a new color, call the plumber about the dripping faucet, and plan a short trip to visit my cousins next month. By the way, my grandmother's maiden name was Kowalczyk, a Polish surname from my family's side.
My teammate at work is David.
David's wife is named Sarah.
Sarah works as a pediatrician at City Hospital.
David is my best friend.
David has a daughter named Emma.
On Monday I worked on the Alpha project.
On Tuesday I worked on the Beta project.
On Wednesday I started the Gamma project.
I live in Boston.
I work at Acme Corp.
I like coffee.
I like tea.
I'm called Alice.
I have a cat named Luna.
I live in Seattle.
I work at Globex.
I'm called Carol.
I have a cat named Luna.
I am a vegetarian.
I love hiking on weekends.
I am allergic to peanuts.
I don't like horror movies.
I have been running every morning for five years.
My favorite color is teal.
I grew up in a small town in Oregon.
Always back up the database before deploying.
Never push directly to the main branch.
I must review all pull requests before merging.
Make sure to log out of shared devices after use.
If the build fails, I have to check the CI logs first.
Don't forget to update the changelog for each release.
I live in New York.
I enjoy playing chess on rainy days.
I live in Paris.
My credit card number is 4111-1111-1111-1111.

questions.query: What is my profession?
questions.expected: 命中包含 'software engineer' 的记忆

questions.query: Where do I live?

questions.query: Which project am I working on now?

questions.query: What did I work on after the Alpha project?
